prompts.short: Make the two existing people hug. Preserve each person's face, hair, clothing and body identity, the background, and the original camera view.
prompts.structured: A is the person on the right in the source image. B is the person on the left in the source image. Make the two existing people hug. A and B face toward one another. Keep A and B close together. A keeps the left hand at shoulder level and the right hand near waist level. A keeps the left elbow bent. A keeps the right elbow bent. A brings an arm around the other person's upper body. B keeps the left hand at shoulder level and the right hand near waist level. B bends the left elbow tightly. B keeps the right elbow bent. B brings an arm around the other person's upper body. Preserve each person's face, hair, clothing and body identity, the background, and the original camera view.

provenance.inputs: source mask anchors + action label + external geometry only

generation_provenance.identity_scope: pair holdout; global cross-pair actor IDs were not proven

text_provenance.short: action label only; no target geometry descriptions
text_provenance.structured: source actor anchors, action label and reliable external target geometry descriptions; no target RGB

limitations: One held-out pair cannot establish overall generalization or the two-person quality threshold.
Both structured prompts describe reliable external target geometry; only adapter comparisons receive explicit dense/graph/contact geometry controls.
Pair holdout does not prove global actor identity disjointness across pairs.
DINO is a clothing/appearance proxy; generated person crops are DWPose spatial proxies.
Missing actors/faces/meshes stay NA and coverage denominators are explicit.
Multi-HMR contact is unsigned estimated camera-space proximity; signed penetration is unavailable.
